problem: Nemotron Super HQQ4+k4v4 had a large unexplained startup VRAM gap versus Qwen3.5-122B, which capped Super prefill at about 5K tokens and suppressed benchmark prefill speed.
root_causes: The HQQ BF16 attention release path skipped Nemotron Super full-GQA layers whose BF16 projections live in layer.gqa_weights while attention is None.
The HQQ GQA decode descriptors built identical full-context RoPE cos/sin tables once per Super GQA layer, then the global Rust RoPE table built another copy.
implemented_changes: Release HQQ-replaced GQA projection tensors from layer.gqa_weights even when the layer has no attention object.
Cache HQQ GQA RoPE cos/sin tables by exact runtime parameters: device, max_seq, rope half width, theta, head dim, Gemma flag, and layer RoPE params.
Reuse the matching HQQ GQA RoPE table for the shared Rust decode RoPE table instead of allocating another identical table.

known_structural_causes: Super has larger resident Mamba2/shared-expert/runtime footprint than Q122 after full load.
Super prefill scratch still grows faster, so calibration still caps Super at 7422 tokens instead of Q122's long 20K regime.
